BuildingBlockModule.name: Modules.Promotions

ModuleMeta.Name: Promotions Module
ModuleMeta.Description: Domain-driven design module for promotion and coupon management. Defines aggregate roots (Promotion, CouponCode, PromotionCategory) and supporting entities (PromotionAction, PromotionRule, OrderPromotion). Provides promotion action types (CreateAdjustment, CreateItemAdjustments, CreateLineItems, FreeShipping), rule types (Country, Currency, CustomerGroup, FirstOrder, ItemTotal, OneUsePerUser, OptionValue, Product, Taxon, User, UserLoggedIn), handler services (Cart, Coupon, FreeShipping, Page), and batch coupon code generation. Consumed by API controllers, application services, and persistence infrastructure.
ModuleMeta.StandardsAlignment: Evans DDD, SOLID, Vertical Slice Architecture

Principle.name: Sealed Partial Classes
Principle.Description: Every domain entity is a sealed partial class split across multiple files by concern.
Principle.Rationale: Enables per-concern partial files (Extensions, Validation, Constants, Loggers, Result) while preventing inheritance misuse. Follows the existing codebase pattern.

Principle.name: Result Pattern for Business Logic
Principle.Description: All factory methods and business operations return Result<T> to encode success or failure without exceptions.
Principle.Rationale: Avoids exceptions for expected business rule violations. Callers must inspect result state rather than catching exceptions.

Principle.name: CAT-10 Annotations at Module Entry Points
Principle.Description: Every entity class carries an Invariant annotation. Every public factory method carries a Contract annotation.
Principle.Rationale: Provides machine-parseable contracts for AI coding agents and static analysis tools as recommended by the v3.0 Code Commenting Standard.

Category.name: Promotions
Category.Description: Core promotion entity with lifecycle management, eligibility, and activation.

Abstraction.name: Promotion
Abstraction.Description: Aggregate root representing a discount or offer with rules, actions, date ranges, and match policies.
Abstraction.Purpose: Create, update, activate, deactivate, and evaluate promotion eligibility against orders.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Name != null; StartsAtUtc <= ExpiresAtUtc when both set; UsageLimit > 0 when set; Kind is CouponCode or Automatic
Abstraction.TopUse: Defining a new promotional campaign with rules and actions.

Abstraction.name: PromotionAction
Abstraction.Description: Entity representing a single action (discount or gift) performed by a promotion.
Abstraction.Purpose: Configure action type, preferences, and calculator for order-level or line-item adjustments.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Type is always set; Preferences is never null; CalculatorType is nullable for non-calculator actions

Abstraction.name: PromotionRule
Abstraction.Description: Entity representing a condition that must be met for promotion eligibility.
Abstraction.Purpose: Define eligibility conditions (product, user, taxon, item total, etc.) with typed preferences.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Type is always set; Preferences is never null; PromotionId must reference a valid Promotion

Abstraction.name: PromotionCategory
Abstraction.Description: Aggregate root for grouping promotions into named categories.
Abstraction.Purpose: Organize promotions by category with optional code and presentation labels.

Abstraction.name: OrderPromotion
Abstraction.Description: Join entity linking a promotion to an order with optional coupon code reference.
Abstraction.Purpose: Track which promotions were applied to which orders.

Category.name: Coupon Codes
Category.Description: Single-use and multi-use coupon code management with batch generation.

Abstraction.name: CouponCode
Abstraction.Description: Aggregate root for an individual coupon code with state lifecycle (Active, Redeemed, Expired, Canceled).
Abstraction.Purpose: Redeem, expire, and cancel individual coupon codes against orders.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Code is unique per promotion; State transitions: Active->Redeemed->Expired or Active->Canceled

Abstraction.name: CouponCodeBuilder
Abstraction.Description: Static utility for generating batches of unique coupon codes with optional prefix.
Abstraction.Purpose: Generate 1 to 10,000 coupon codes in a single call with dedup and prefix support.

Category.name: Actions (Domain Services)
Category.Description: Concrete promotion action implementations ported from Spree::Promotion::Actions.

Abstraction.name: PromotionActionBase
Abstraction.Description: Abstract base class for all promotion actions with Perform, ComputeAmount, and Revert contracts.
Abstraction.Purpose: Define the common contract that all promotion action types must implement.

Abstraction.name: CreateAdjustmentAction
Abstraction.Description: Order-level adjustment action using a calculator to compute discount amount.
Abstraction.Purpose: Apply a percentage or flat-rate discount to the entire order total.

Abstraction.name: CreateItemAdjustmentsAction
Abstraction.Description: Line-item-level adjustment action applied per eligible line item.
Abstraction.Purpose: Apply discounts to individual line items based on calculator and line item eligibility.

Abstraction.name: CreateLineItemsAction
Abstraction.Description: Adds free line items to the order when the promotion is eligible.
Abstraction.Purpose: Provide gift-with-purchase or free-sample promotions by adding items to the cart.

Abstraction.name: FreeShippingAction
Abstraction.Description: Zero-cost shipping adjustment applied to each shipment on the order.
Abstraction.Purpose: Set shipment costs to zero when the promotion is eligible.

Category.name: Rules (Domain Services)
Category.Description: Concrete promotion rule implementations ported from Spree::Promotion::Rules.

Abstraction.name: PromotionRuleBase
Abstraction.Description: Abstract base class for all promotion rules with Applicable, Eligible, and Actionable contracts.
Abstraction.Purpose: Define the common contract that all promotion rule types must implement.

Abstraction.name: CountryRule
Abstraction.Description: Restricts promotion to orders shipping to a specific country (by ID or ISO code).
Abstraction.Purpose: Limit promotion eligibility by shipment destination country.

Abstraction.name: CurrencyRule
Abstraction.Description: Restricts promotion to orders using a specific currency.
Abstraction.Purpose: Limit promotion eligibility by order currency (e.g., USD only).

Abstraction.name: CustomerGroupRule
Abstraction.Description: Restricts promotion to users belonging to specific customer groups.
Abstraction.Purpose: Implement B2B or loyalty-tier promotions by customer group membership.

Abstraction.name: FirstOrderRule
Abstraction.Description: Restricts promotion to a customer's first completed order.
Abstraction.Purpose: Welcome or first-purchase discount offers.

Abstraction.name: ItemTotalRule
Abstraction.Description: Restricts promotion based on order item total with configurable min/max thresholds.
Abstraction.Purpose: Implement minimum-purchase or tiered-spend promotions.

Abstraction.name: OneUsePerUserRule
Abstraction.Description: Restricts promotion to a single use per user across all orders.
Abstraction.Purpose: Prevent repeat usage of limited-use promotions.

Abstraction.name: OptionValueRule
Abstraction.Description: Restricts promotion to line items with specific option values (size, color, etc.).
Abstraction.Purpose: Create promotions for specific variant attributes.

Abstraction.name: ProductRule
Abstraction.Description: Restricts promotion based on products in the order with any/all/none match policies.
Abstraction.Purpose: Buy-X-get-Y or exclusion-based promotions.

Abstraction.name: TaxonRule
Abstraction.Description: Restricts promotion to products within specific taxon categories (including children).
Abstraction.Purpose: Category-wide promotions that apply to all subcategories.

Abstraction.name: UserRule
Abstraction.Description: Restricts promotion to a specific list of users.
Abstraction.Purpose: VIP or test-user-only promotions.

Abstraction.name: UserLoggedInRule
Abstraction.Description: Restricts promotion to authenticated users (guest checkout excluded).
Abstraction.Purpose: Logged-in-user-only discount offers.

Category.name: Handler Services
Category.Description: Promotion handler services ported from Spree::PromotionHandler.

Abstraction.name: CartHandler
Abstraction.Description: Activates or deactivates store promotions when cart content changes.
Abstraction.Purpose: Trigger promotion evaluation on cart updates and line item changes.

Abstraction.name: CouponHandler
Abstraction.Description: Applies or removes coupon codes on orders with full eligibility validation.
Abstraction.Purpose: Handle coupon code entry, validation, activation, and removal from orders.

Abstraction.name: FreeShippingHandler
Abstraction.Description: Activates free-shipping promotions applicable to the current order.
Abstraction.Purpose: Evaluate and apply shipping-related promotions separately from cart handlers.

Abstraction.name: PageHandler
Abstraction.Description: Activates promotions associated with a specific URL path.
Abstraction.Purpose: Support promotions triggered by visiting a specific page or campaign URL.

Abstraction.name: PromotionDuplicator
Abstraction.Description: Clones an existing promotion with new name, code, path and copied rules/actions.
Abstraction.Purpose: Allow merchants to duplicate promotions as a starting point for new campaigns.

Feature.name: Promotion Definition & Lifecycle
Feature.Description: Define promotions with activation rules, date ranges, and usage limits. Lifecycle: draft → active → inactive → archived. Bulk activate/deactivate with duplicate support.

Feature.name: Eligibility Rule Engine
Feature.Description: Composable rule system: cart total thresholds, product/category filters, customer group matching, coupon code validation. Rules evaluate in sequence; all must pass.

Feature.name: Discount Action System
Feature.Description: Actions define what happens when a promotion applies: percent discount, fixed amount, free shipping, buy-one-get-one. Each action has a calculator and configurable parameters.

AntiPattern.name: Mutating Preferences Dictionary Directly
AntiPattern.Avoid: Directly setting action.Preferences[key] = value outside SetPreference extension method.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Always use the SetPreference extension method for traceability and validation.

AntiPattern.name: Bypassing Eligibility Checks
AntiPattern.Avoid: Calling promotion.Activate without first checking promotion.Eligible on the order.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Always run the full eligibility pipeline (rules, date range, usage limits) before activation.

Mechanism.name: Promotion Eligibility Pipeline
Mechanism.Scope: Determining if a promotion applies to an order

Steps.Step: Check promotion is active and within date range
Evaluate each PromotionRule: all rules must pass
Validate coupon code if promotion requires one
If all pass, compute action and apply to order

Mechanism.name: Coupon Code Generation
Mechanism.Pattern: CouponCode.Generate(prefix, length) → generates cryptographically random alphanumeric code with configurable prefix (e.g., "SAVE20-XK9M2")

Scenario.title: Create and Activate a Promotion
Scenario.Context: Admin creates a 20% off sale for orders over $100.

Benefits.Benefit: Activation is explicit, not automatic on creation
